Linh (support): Hi @Jane — saw your ticket, sorry about the outage. Can you share the org id and an approx timestamp when you first saw 0 credits?
Jane (ACME): Org: acme-42. We hit 0 right around midnight PST. We got a flood of 429s on our streaming sockets, then ~2 minutes later credits started to trickle back and things recovered.
Tom (eng): Thanks. Do you have a session id / client id for the long-lived websocket?
Jane (ACME): session=abc123. It's a long-running ws that streams assistant tokens to the client, we never reconnect on normal conditions.
SREbot: Correlation: token consumption spike for tenant acme-42 between 2026-03-01T07:59:58Z and 2026-03-01T08:05:12Z. Token bucket depleted at 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z.
Linh (support): Can you reproduce tomorrow during your rostering window? If so, please run this quick request to capture headers/logs: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
Jane (ACME): We'll try. Quick question — why did credits come back slowly instead of all at once at reset?
Tom (eng): Two things likely at play: 1) Streaming sessions consume tokens continuously; long-lived connections can keep a lot of in-flight accounting which means the token bucket looks drained until the session checkpoints. 2) Our UI reads a cached tenant balance from a read-replica which is invalidated on refill events — there was a short delay in that invalidation path so the dashboard showed 0 while backend refill was already processing.
Linh (support): Short-term mitigation: 1) a client should treat 429s by backing off then reconnecting after Retry-After; 2) we'll issue an emergency one-time top-up for acme-42 to remove immediate 429s.
Tom (eng): Added a targeted fix: invalidate tenant UI cache on refill events (rolling deploy in progress). Also putting a guard in the streaming accounting path to emit a soft-refund when a session closes unexpectedly so long-lived sessions don't permanently pin bucket usage.
Jane (ACME): Confirmed top-up removed the 429s for now. Appreciate the fast action.
Linh (support): Follow-ups: we will (a) include recommended client retry/backoff guidance in KB, (b) add a short postmortem entry once deploys land. Will update this thread with deploy times. :thumbsup:
Tom (eng): Deploys: cache invalidation patch -> 2026-03-01T10:15Z, streaming accounting guard -> 2026-03-02T02:00Z window.
Jane (ACME): Sounds good. We'll implement reconnect/backoff on our side. Thanks all.
Linh (support): Closing loop once both fixes are verified in staging/Prod. If anything recurs please reopen.
